beyond_json_schema: point_rows IDs equal all frozen point IDs exactly once; no drops
boundary rows equal fixed boundary subset; do not add twice to A_cov
insuff rows IDs exactly I01/I02/I03 when applicable, empty otherwise
score=.5 only if exact predeclared noncritical partial branch applies
scored has numeric score; unknown has null; tested failure/missing coverage=0
span quote equals source[channel][start:end], in bounds; no fabricated quotes
full factual claim includes subject, time, negation, modality and necessary conditions
dedup claim IDs and (claim,citation) pairs; conditions reference existing claims
id_valid iff frozen card exists and actual complete returned ID present
actual available requires complete support DNF and conditions, not relevant ID alone
pair error IDs stable across A/B, not error synonyms; issue mapping total and unique
all applicable units double rated, third triggered or reserved; originals immutable
absence/omission reasons need not invent source spans; report explicit missing reference
unknown backend stays null; configured identity not proof of returned identity
validation_limit: synthetic structural/arithmetic validation does not establish model semantic reliability
